title: Order status desk: one omnichannel AI agent for web chat and phone
alias: omnichannel AI agent with chat-to-call handoff and context
also_known_as: text and voice on one agent
summary: An order status demo built to show one AI agent serving web chat and phone calls, with the conversation moving between the two without starting over. It answers questions about order status and declines everything else, on purpose.
scenario: A customer asks about an order in web chat, escalates to a call, and the voice agent already knows the thread
